OTOLARYNGOLOGICAL.layman_explanation_en: Long-term inflammation of the voice box (larynx) and vocal cords, causing a raspy or lost voice.
symptoms_en: Hoarseness, raspy voice, or complete loss of voice
Tickling sensation and raw soreness in throat
Constant urge to clear throat and dry cough

symptoms: Difficulty understanding speech in crowded rooms
Asking people to repeat themselves frequently
Turning up TV or radio volume higher than others prefer
